newsitem.title: USA: First Data, Chase form merchant processing unit.
newsitem.headline: First Data, Chase form merchant processing unit.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Bank and First Data Corp, said Monday they will form a merchant processing business with an initial portfolio of nearly $90 billion in annual credit, debit and card sales.
Chase Merchant Services will offer processing and related services to merchants for credit, debit and stored value cards.

Chase will provide clearing and settlement, and First Data will provide merchant processing services and back office operations, the companies said. Both will provide sales and marketing support. The joint venture is expected to begin operating in the first quarter of 1997.
"The new company's capabilities will strategically position Chase in the forefront of a rapidly emerging area of electronic commerce," Chase said in a release.
Robert McNamara, formerly president of First Data Client Merchant Services, will become chief executive officer of the venture, the companies said.
